metric_definitions.data_labels: Observed, simulated and unknown origins are never pooled. Only explicitly observed inputs may supply future empirical reporting; labels are user assertions.
metric_definitions.denominators: T=validated verified-source lookups; N=FOUND or NOT_FOUND lookups only.
metric_definitions.identity_undetermined_rate: FOUND lookups with undetermined original rank-one identity / N.
metric_definitions.incorrect_match_rate: I1/N; exact only when U1=0. Bounds I1/N to (I1+U1)/N.
metric_definitions.provider_error_rate: Number of TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED or API_ERROR lookups / T.
metric_definitions.recall_at_1: H1/N; exact only when U1=0. Bounds H1/N to (H1+U1)/N.
metric_definitions.recall_at_5: H5/N; exact only when U5=0. Bounds H5/N to (H5+U5)/N.
metric_definitions.recall_states: HK=confirmed hit within original ranks <=K; UK=unresolved identity/parse gap without a confirmed hit; MK=confirmed miss. HK+UK+MK=N.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Evidence bounds are not confidence intervals. Zero denominator yields null. Different identifiers alone never prove INCORRECT; distinctness needs provenance.
metric_definitions.unknown_outcome_rate: Number of UNKNOWN lookups / T; excluded from retrieval metrics.
metric_definitions.unresolved_rate: Number of valid NOT_FOUND lookups / N.
metric_definitions.weighting: Each lookup has equal weight. Mutations share original_citation_id; no independence, uncertainty-estimation or statistical-significance claim is made.
